message: 感じる感触

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's dark in here... Hard to see, too...」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Please don't press up against me so much.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... sorry.」

name: Misa
message: 「Pressing yourself against Onee-sama on purpose--you're the worst, Sakura-kun!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah, Lord Synn! And here I was enjoying the sheer bliss of being squished by Ria-chan's boobs!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why is Paqy-san so awful despite being so cute?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't even try to play dumb!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan. Don't you feel it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Even coming from you, Onee-sama, that's cruel. I'm not getting turned on by Sakura-kun!」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, well, I mean, not like that\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Here they come!」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」
Encountered Cat-Eared Demons!

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't notice them because Sakura-kun kept doing weird things!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm being falsely accused!」

name: Paqy
message: 「This is bad! There's no time to transform!」
Having perhaps sensed our approach, they were waiting in an orderly formation.
We haven't made any preparations at all.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, Ria-senpai! I'll draw their attention, so transform while I do」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll be the decoy!」

name: Ria
message: 「No! It's way too dangerous!」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」
At a shout from someone who looked like their captain, the demons began an orderly retreat.

name: Misa
message: 「Huh... what's going on?」

name: Ria
message: 「They would've had the advantage if they fought us right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「So... they really don't intend to fight us, huh」
In the darkness, not even a trace of the Demons' presence remains.

name: Synn
message: 「What are they even... doing at this academy in the first place?」
